description: Mandatory surrogate key SavingsAccountSK must not be NULL.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE SavingsAccountSK IS NULL

description: Mandatory natural key AccountNumber must not be NULL.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE AccountNumber IS NULL

description: Mandatory DateSK must not be NULL.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE DateSK IS NULL

description: Mandatory LoadDate must not be NULL (every fact row must have ETL load timestamp).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE LoadDate IS NULL

description: Mandatory Balance must not be NULL.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE Balance IS NULL

description: Surrogate key SavingsAccountSK must be unique in the fact (no duplicate PK values).
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN (SELECT SavingsAccountSK FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE SavingsAccountSK IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SavingsAccountSK HAVING COUNT(*)>1) dup ON f.SavingsAccountSK = dup.SavingsAccountSK

description: Referential integrity: SavingsAccountSK must exist in pres.DimSavingsAccount.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f LEFT JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE f.SavingsAccountSK IS NOT NULL AND d.SavingsAccountSK IS NULL

description: Referential integrity: DateSK must reference an existing pres.DimDate.DateSK.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f LEFT JOIN pres.DimDate d ON f.DateSK = d.DateSK WHERE f.DateSK IS NOT NULL AND d.DateSK IS NULL

description: DateSK should follow YYYYMMDD integer convention (must be an 8-digit positive integer between 19000101 and 99991231).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE DateSK IS NOT NULL AND (DateSK < 19000101 OR DateSK > 99991231)

description: Business rule: Balance must be 0.00 when the account status in pres.DimSavingsAccount is 'Closed'.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE d.AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND (f.Balance IS NULL OR f.Balance <> 0.00)

description: When InterestRate is present it should be non-negative (rates cannot be negative unless product allows negative interest).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE InterestRate IS NOT NULL AND InterestRate < 0

description: AccountNumber in fact should match AccountNumber in referenced pres.DimSavingsAccount for the same SavingsAccountSK (consistency between fact and dimension).
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE f.AccountNumber IS NOT NULL AND d.AccountNumber IS NOT NULL AND f.AccountNumber <> d.AccountNumber

description: Multiple snapshot rows for the same SavingsAccountSK and DateSK (duplicate fact snapshot for same business date) are not allowed.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN (SELECT SavingsAccountSK, DateSK FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount WHERE SavingsAccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DateSK IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SavingsAccountSK, DateSK HAVING COUNT(*)>1) dup ON f.SavingsAccountSK = dup.SavingsAccountSK AND f.DateSK = dup.DateSK
